selection_rule: learner action -> observed operation/modality -> accessible capability -> justified variety; load only selected pattern spec

patterns.assessment: accepted variants plus context; no answer before attempt

patterns.goal: compose meaningful language chunks into a grammatical utterance, distinct from word-by-word card ordering
patterns.input: meaning-chunk builder with reorder/reset or a structured text fallback
patterns.assessment: accuracy plus independent retry in different context

patterns.goal: retrieve English word or phrase after seeing a real picture
patterns.input: real image with native text input directly beneath and accessible text fallback
patterns.assessment: case-insensitive expected word plus accepted aliases can be locally checked; written image-prompted recall only

patterns.goal: understand a real short passage and distinguish gist from evidence details
patterns.input: continuous readable passage with two short gist/detail prompts
patterns.assessment: ground to passage; text reading only, no listening claims

patterns.goal: notice and repair a specific error
patterns.assessment: corrected meaning and new independent example
meaning and context, not exact token matching alone

patterns.input: text box or accessible speech tool
two or more responsive real ChatGPT turns, not one static text field
actually accessible audio track, replay/speed if supported, gist and detail questions
patterns.assessment: gist and detail; never simulate an unheard recording

patterns.goal: order individual cards into a sentence, with click-to-order and Undo
reconstruct causal/temporal event sequence from a story
patterns.input: tap to order events with Undo and keyboard fallback
patterns.assessment: trusted unique sequence, or defer ambiguous/tied event order

patterns.goal: identify an item in a real image
patterns.input: relevant image plus accessible labeled choices

patterns.goal: identify a specified region/object within an actual image
patterns.input: real relevant image with genuinely actionable, keyboard-accessible region controls
patterns.assessment: trusted semantic region IDs; never grade fabricated clicks or inaccessible image

patterns.input: genuine accessible microphone/audio recording and playback; typed rehearsal is not speaking evidence

feedback.timing: on input change after first response

listening: audioPlayback with real audio source actually available
capability_gates.fallback_principle: If unavailable, explicitly change modality/type and show unassessed for the requested one; never fabricate audio, image clicks, or spoken evidence.

interaction_quality.lesson_completion: count required unanswered items; incomplete does not unlock finale; one Submit or explicit incomplete early exit
interaction_quality.candidate_first_try: capture initial answer, revisions and hint level; untrusted local metadata is never mastery
interaction_quality.dialogue: require two or more real exchanges for sustained interaction assessment; a single typed reply is preparation only
interaction_quality.popovers: keep story sentence continuous; move term-help control outside line if native popover breaks text
interaction_quality.progress_explorer: read-only verified learner evidence, never a fabricated proficiency percentage
